purpose: Chosen engineering baseline for the clocked 4x4 sense/ADC wrapper. Numeric limits are targets, not measured ADC/PVT or sign-off results.

candidate_core_stimulus.source: Cell 4.9: 101/101 TT PEX; cell 4.10: 16/16 held-out TT PEX; combined minimum pooled adjacent gap 0.0020125 V

decoder.calibration_method: per-column auto-zero plus common-mode-binned monotone threshold table; calibrate with physical reference patterns at each supported PVT point; reject out-of-range common mode
decoder.note: Seven bits encode the signed integer output, not seven bits of demonstrated analog precision. Threshold DAC/reference and comparator must resolve the measured ~2 mV nearest-level gap; common-mode sensing is a design choice, not a proven cure.

timing.note: Targets only. 1.9 and 2.1 ns are isolated PEX samples, not a proven continuous aperture. Twenty ns matches the existing digital clock target; converter latency and throughput are unmeasured.

acceptance.budget_note: At a 2 mV adjacent gap, midpoint allowance is ~1 mV. Offset 0.15 mV + reference error 0.15 mV + aperture shift 0.10 mV + 5 sigma noise 0.40 mV = 0.80 mV target. This is a stringent unverified feasibility gate; 117 deterministic patterns cannot establish a 1e-6 error rate.

pvt_plan.note: Three-point screen is a debug step only. The proposed 27-point matrix requires server PDK/model verification and review before sign-off.
